name: Simple Tuna Salad
author: scary90 on based.cooking

ingredients.item: 2 tbsp white vinegar or lemon juice (optional)

steps: In a medium bowl, stir together tuna, mayonnaise, and relish.
Add optional ingredients like vinegar, cheese or hard-boiled eggs if wanted.
Season with garlic powder, salt, and pepper if wanted.

culture.text: A salad is a dish consisting of mixed ingredients, frequently vegetables. They are typically served chilled or at room temperature, though some can be served warm. Condiments called salad dressings, which exist in a variety of flavors, are usually used to make a salad.
